parameters.query:
SELECT 
  DATE(cl.date) AS date,
  cl.user_id AS agent,
  ccd.sourcesofcomplaint,
  COUNT(*) AS CaseLogged
FROM call_complaint_log cl
INNER JOIN call_complaint cc ON cc.id = cl.pro_complaint_id
INNER JOIN call_complaint_details ccd ON ccd.id = cc.complaint_id
WHERE cc.date >= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.from }} 00:00:00'
AND cc.date <= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.to }} 23:59:59'
AND cl.user_id IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
AND cl.id = (
  SELECT MIN(cl2.id) 
  FROM call_complaint_log cl2 
  WHERE cl2.pro_complaint_id = cl.pro_complaint_id
)
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id, ccd.sourcesofcomplaint
ORDER BY DATE(cl.date) ASC, cl.user_id ASC;

SELECT 
  DATE(cl.date) AS date,
  cl.user_id AS agent,
  COUNT(*) AS CasesClosed
FROM call_complaint_log cl
WHERE cl.date >= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.from }} 00:00:00'
AND cl.date <= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.to }} 23:59:59'
AND cl.complaint_status = 'Resolved'
AND cl.user_id IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id
ORDER BY DATE(cl.date) ASC, cl.user_id ASC

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { date: item.json.date, agent: item.json.agent, CasesClosed: item.json.CasesClosed, dataType: 'casesclosed' } }));

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  DATE(rl.created) AS date,
  rl.userid AS agent,
  COUNT(*) AS Reassigned
FROM call_reassign_engineer_logs rl
WHERE rl.created >= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.from }} 00:00:00'
AND rl.created <= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.to }} 23:59:59'
AND rl.userid IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
GROUP BY DATE(rl.created), rl.userid
ORDER BY DATE(rl.created) ASC, rl.userid ASC

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { date: item.json.date, agent: item.json.agent, Reassigned: item.json.Reassigned, dataType: 'reassigned' } }));

parameters.query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, agent_name AS agent, case_update AS CaseUpdate
FROM calls.crm_daily_summary
WHERE service_id = 338
  AND report_date >= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.from }}'
  AND report_date <= '{{ $('On Nihon Productivity Request').first().json.query.to }}'
ORDER BY report_date ASC, agent_name ASC

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { date: item.json.date, agent: item.json.agent, CaseUpdate: item.json.CaseUpdate, dataType: 'caseupdate' } }));
